source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The comm port uses strong dom::NodeList references for child offsets, first-child anchor inspection and recursive element conversion. It uses dom::ContentList for meta-refresh removal while preserving backward traversal during removal. These exact caller contracts explain why the index/order remains. The original Length(true) and later accepted Length() belong to different phases. The unpaired engine revision does not establish collection or build guarantees.
title: The DOM collection port keeps each caller's indexed or reverse traversal
